about: The contract keywords the compiler accepts (contract-lab/lib/contract_lab/compiler.ex): its reserved words minus removed forms, plus connector words of its grammar. bandhighlight.py must mark exactly these; contract-lab/test/band_keywords_test.exs checks this record against the compiler.

removed.due:
---
name: removed-due
description: The due form was removed.
engine: 0.2.0-lab.1
roles: [lead, reviewer]
---
contract @1h => expired
type review
state new
  due all of {lead,reviewer} with review in 5m => stalled
  lead -> reviewer: review() => done
end done
end stalled
removed.failure:
---
name: removed-failure
description: The collect failure line was removed.
engine: 0.2.0-lab.1
roles: [lead, reviewer]
extensions: [room.contributions/1]
---
contract @1h => expired
type report
type oops
state new
  lead -> reviewer: report() => collecting
state collecting
  collect reports from reviewer -> lead @10m => done
    reply report()
    failure oops()
end done
